subject: Quick question on product roadmap webinar
body:
Hi Tom,

Hope you’re doing well! Just confirming the details for our upcoming live walkthrough of the Q1 roadmap for design partners. Could you please let me know if everything looks good to go with what we’ve planned?

Best,
Sofia

events.reply:
Hi Sofia,

I can't place this. Which webinar and which roadmap do you mean, and who are the design partners? Please send the date, the agenda and who on our side you've been talking to.

Tom
